summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) across 7 plans in 4 waves, implementing SDK pinning abstractions, API endpoints, settings UI, migration backend, and performance benchmarks.
summary.outcome: Waves 1-3 completed fully (plans 21-01 through 21-05). Wave 4 is in progress — 21-06 reached a human-verify checkpoint after building migration progress UI, and 21-07 (benchmarks) is still running. Phase not yet verified or closed.

repo: The web app does not have @noble/ed25519 as a direct dependency — HKDF/ed25519 derivations must go through @cipherbox/crypto package (deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair pattern), not inlined in the web app.
BYO config is stored encrypted via ECIES in a dedicated IPNS entry, separate from the vault key IPNS entry — zero-knowledge design preserved.
Migration job system uses BullMQ with a NestJS processor; TEE worker has a separate migration route with SSRF protection for provider endpoint validation.
Dev environment uses a QEMU VM guest connecting to Docker services on the host via a bridge network (192.168.133.x subnet) — DHCP can reassign the host IP, requiring .env updates.
The isByoUser flag lives on the vault entity and is toggled via setByoStatus() in vault.service.ts; quota enforcement becomes advisory (non-enforced) for BYO users.

code.finding: Contains hardcoded host IP (192.168.133.114) for Redis, PostgreSQL, and IPFS — DHCP reassigned to 192.168.133.12, requiring manual update of all 5 references.
Added deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair following the same pattern as deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair — required because web app lacks @noble/ed25519 as a direct dep.
Save handler encrypts BYO config via ECIES and publishes to dedicated IPNS entry; also ECIES-wraps configs with TEE public key on provider change to trigger migration.
isUserByo() and setByoStatus() methods control BYO mode; advisory quota logic lives here alongside standard quota enforcement.

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution works well for independent plans — 21-01/21-02 and 21-04/21-05 ran truly in parallel with no conflicts.
Checkpoint plans (autonomous: false) block the wave but parallel non-checkpoint plans complete independently — 21-05 finished while waiting for 21-04 checkpoint approval.
Dev environment connectivity issues (host IP changes) should be debugged by checking the gateway IP first (ip route show default) rather than assuming the configured IP is still valid.
OTP extraction from API console logs is a useful debugging shortcut during dev verification sessions.

friction: Docker stack host IP changed after restart (DHCP reassigned 192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), blocking API startup and requiring manual .env edits across 5 references.

QEMU VM network topology made debugging confusing — the VM cannot reach the host at 192.168.133.114 because that IP is the host's address on a different interface, not reachable from the guest bridge.
Redis port mismatch suspicion (6379 vs 6380) was a red herring — actual issue was the host IP change.
Two background `pnpm dev` processes were killed before producing useful output, requiring multiple restarts to get a stable dev server.
open_items: 21-06 checkpoint verification pending — user needs to test the complete BYO-IPFS feature E2E in the browser including migration progress UI.
21-07 (BYO performance benchmarks) still running — load test scenarios comparing BYO vs CipherBox-only baseline from Phase 19.2.
Phase 21 verification (gsd-verifier) not yet run — VERIFICATION.md not created.
apps/api/.env has hardcoded host IP — should be made dynamic or use a stable hostname to survive Docker stack restarts.
